name: soft-teacher_independent-5k-4gpu-20261023
description: Soft ladder on 5k: teacher_independent, 4xH100, seed 43, 79 steps
command:
set -uo pipefail
R=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish
V=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare/.venv-sii
M=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare/models/Qwen3.5-4B
D=$R/data/multiselect_grouped_multi_5k
DEV=$R/data/multiselect_grouped_multi/dev.jsonl
OUT=$R/runs/qz/soft_teacher_independent_5k_seed43/v1
LOG=$R/logs/qz/soft_teacher_independent_5k_seed43.log
mkdir -p "$R/logs/qz" "$OUT"
cd "$R"
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
"$V/bin/python" -I "$R/harness/train_multiselect.py" --validate-only \
  --train "$D/train.jsonl" --dev "$DEV" \
  --model "$M" --modules "$R/innerjev/configs/4B/modules.json" \
  --objective set --set-loss independent_marginal --count-weight 1 --target-file /inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/qz/teacher_gold5k_20261023/targets_train.jsonl --world-size 4 --global-batch 64 \
  --max-input-tokens 8192 --max-batch-tokens 8192 \
  --validate-output "$R/logs/qz/soft_teacher_independent_5k_seed43_validate.json" \
  > "$R/logs/qz/soft_teacher_independent_5k_seed43_validate.log" 2>&1 || { echo "validation failed"; tail -60 "$R/logs/qz/soft_teacher_independent_5k_seed43_validate.log"; exit 3; }
"$V/bin/torchrun" --standalone --nnodes 1 --nproc_per_node 4 \
  "$R/harness/train_multiselect.py" \
  --train "$D/train.jsonl" --dev "$DEV" \
  --model "$M" --modules "$R/innerjev/configs/4B/modules.json" \
  --objective set --set-loss independent_marginal --count-weight 1 --target-file /inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/qz/teacher_gold5k_20261023/targets_train.jsonl --output "$OUT" \
  --lr 2e-6 --global-batch 64 --epochs 1 \
  --max-input-tokens 8192 --max-batch-tokens 8192 \
  --eval-every-frac 0.2 --lambda-g 0 --graph none --seed 43 --expect-trainable 3313500160 \
  > "$LOG" 2>&1
status=$?; echo "JOB EXIT=$status"; exit $status
